newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecom bill enroute to Congress.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecom bill enroute to Congress.

text.p: A long-awaited bill containing Brazil's new General Telecommunications Law was slated to be handed to Congress' lower house at 1100 local/1300 GMT by Communications Minister Sergio Motta, a ministry spokesman said.
"There's always a slight delay, but it should be on its way," the spokesman said.
The ministry has set a news conference for 1030 local/1230 GMT on Friday to explain and answer questions on the proposed law.
Motta was expected to personally hand the document to Dep. Luis Eduardo Magalhaes, president of the Chamber of Deputies, the spokesman added.
The law, which will create a regulatory watchdog for the sector, set telecoms policy and outline government plans to break-up and sell off the federal Telebras SA, has been awaited for weeks.
